panels.description: Peak simultaneous in-flight requests per group per $bucket (sweep-line over [startTime, endTime): +1 at start, -1 at end, running sum; a gap shows the max in-flight count reached inside it, including requests still running from before the gap). 2 glm-text requests executing at the same instant = 2.

targets.rawSql:
WITH logs AS (
  SELECT "startTime" AS s, "endTime" AS e, CASE WHEN model_group='model' THEN 'Search Agent' WHEN model_group IN ('glm52','glm5.1-w8a8','glm53','glm5.1') THEN 'glm-text' WHEN model_group IN ('deepseek-v4-flash','deepseek-v4-flash0731') THEN 'deepseek-v4-flash' WHEN model_group='glm53-flash' THEN 'glm53-flash' ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(model_group,''),'<none>') END AS metric
  FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs"
  WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime")
    AND "endTime" > "startTime"
    AND api_key IN (${key_group:sqlstring})
),
events AS (
  SELECT s AS ts, 1 AS delta, metric FROM logs
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e AS ts, -1 AS delta, metric FROM logs
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT ts, delta, metric,
    SUM(delta) OVER (PARTITION BY metric ORDER BY ts, delta DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running
  FROM events
),
grid AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    (SELECT CASE '$bucket' WHEN '1d' THEN date_trunc('day', min(s)) WHEN '7d' THEN date_trunc('day', min(s)) WHEN '12h' THEN date_trunc('day', min(s)) ELSE date_trunc('hour', min(s)) END FROM logs),
    (SELECT max(e) FROM logs),
    '$bucket'::interval) AS gap_start
),
peak_in_gap AS (
  SELECT g.gap_start, o.metric, MAX(o.running) AS peak
  FROM grid g JOIN ordered o
    ON o.ts >= g.gap_start AND o.ts < g.gap_start + '$bucket'::interval
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
carry AS (
  SELECT g.gap_start, m.metric,
    (SELECT o.running FROM ordered o
     WHERE o.metric = m.metric AND o.ts < g.gap_start
     ORDER BY o.ts DESC, o.delta DESC LIMIT 1) AS carry
  FROM grid g CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT metric FROM ordered) m
)
SELECT c.gap_start AS time, c.metric,
  GREATEST(COALESCE(c.carry, 0), COALESCE(p.peak, 0)) AS concurrency
FROM carry c
LEFT JOIN peak_in_gap p ON p.gap_start = c.gap_start AND p.metric = c.metric
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: N5 Concurrency per $bucket (peak overlapping requests)

panels.description: Ctrl+click a legend label to remove just that series (click again to restore). Plain click isolates it instead. | glm53-flash (n+s): non-stream + stream combined. Stream rows use real generation window (endTime - completionStartTime). Non-stream rows are APPROXIMATED with a fixed TTFT of 1 s: generation = E2E - 1 s, TPOT = (E2E - 1 s) / completion_tokens. All other series remain streaming-only.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("startTime", $bucket), CASE WHEN api_key = 'SEARCH_AGENT_KEY' THEN 'Search Agent' WHEN model_group IN ('glm52', 'glm5.1-w8a8', 'glm53', 'glm5.1') THEN 'glm-text' WHEN model_group IN ('deepseek-v4-flash', 'deepseek-v4-flash0731') THEN 'deepseek-v4-flash' WHEN model_group = 'glm53-flash' THEN 'glm53-flash(s)' ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(model_group, ''), '<none>') END AS metric, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("endTime" - "completionStartTime")) * 1000 / NULLIF(completion_tokens, 0))::numeric, 1) AS tpot_ms FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND status = 'success' AND "completionStartTime" > "startTime" AND proxy_server_request->>'stream' = 'true' AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("endTime" - "completionStartTime")) >= 1 AND completion_tokens > 0 AND api_key IN (${key_group:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("startTime", $bucket),
  'glm53-flash (n+s)' AS metric,
  ROUND(AVG(
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(proxy_server_request->>'stream','false') <> 'true'
        THEN (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("endTime" - "startTime")) * 1000 - 1000) / NULLIF(completion_tokens, 0)
      ELSE EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("endTime" - "completionStartTime")) * 1000 / NULLIF(completion_tokens, 0)
    END
  )::numeric, 1) AS tpot_ms
FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs"
WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime")
  AND status = 'success'
  AND model_group = 'glm53-flash'
  AND "endTime" > "startTime"
  AND completion_tokens > 0
  AND api_key IN (${key_group:sqlstring})
  AND (
    (COALESCE(proxy_server_request->>'stream','false') <> 'true'
       AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("endTime" - "startTime")) * 1000 > 1000)
    OR (proxy_server_request->>'stream' = 'true'
       AND "completionStartTime" > "startTime"
       AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("endTime" - "completionStartTime")) >= 1)
  )
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.description: Non-stream (buffered) requests only: gen window < 1s. Time-to-first-token divided by input tokens = prompt processing throughput (ms per input token). Lower = faster.

panels.title: N11 Model Group Business Data Sheet

panels.description: All glm53-flash requests containing image_url parts in the request. image_count = number of image parts parsed from messages. Image-specific token counts are not reported upstream (prompt_tokens_details.image_tokens is null), so input/output tokens are the request totals.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  s."startTime" AS time,
  s.request_id,
  s.metadata->>'user_api_key_alias' AS key_alias,
  s.model_group,
  s.status,
  s.prompt_tokens AS input_tokens,
  s.completion_tokens AS output_tokens,
  ic.imgs AS image_count,
  LEFT(COALESCE(s.metadata->'error_information'->>'error_message','-'),60) AS error
FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" s
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT count(*) AS imgs
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(
    CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.proxy_server_request->'messages')='array'
         THEN s.proxy_server_request->'messages' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) m
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
    CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(m->'content')='array' THEN m->'content' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) c
  WHERE c->>'type'='image_url'
) ic
WHERE $__timeFilter(s."startTime")
  AND s.api_key IN (${key_group:sqlstring})
  AND s.model_group = 'glm53-flash'
  AND ic.imgs > 0
ORDER BY s."startTime" DESC
LIMIT 500

panels.description: Hour of day in Asia/Riyadh local time (startTime is stored UTC; converted +3h). Buckets are hour-of-day across the whole selected time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  LPAD(h.hr::text, 2, '0') AS hour,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.grp = 'glm-text') AS "glm-text",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.grp = 'deepseek-v4-flash') AS "deepseek-v4-flash",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.grp = 'glm53-flash') AS "glm53-flash",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.grp = 'Search Agent') AS "Search Agent",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.grp = '<none>') AS "<none>"
FROM generate_series(0, 23) AS h(hr)
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT "startTime", CASE WHEN api_key = 'SEARCH_AGENT_KEY' THEN 'Search Agent' WHEN model_group IN ('glm52','glm5.1-w8a8','glm53','glm5.1') THEN 'glm-text' WHEN model_group IN ('deepseek-v4-flash','deepseek-v4-flash0731') THEN 'deepseek-v4-flash' ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(model_group,''),'<none>') END AS grp
  FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs"
  WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND api_key IN (${key_group:sqlstring})
) s ON EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (s."startTime" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Riyadh'))::int = h.hr
GROUP BY h.hr
ORDER BY h.hr

SELECT

  COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(s.total_tokens) FILTER (WHERE s.grp = 'glm-text')), 0) AS "glm-text",

  COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(s.total_tokens) FILTER (WHERE s.grp = 'glm53-flash')), 0) AS "glm53-flash",
  COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(s.total_tokens) FILTER (WHERE s.grp = 'Search Agent')), 0) AS "Search Agent",
  COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(s.total_tokens) FILTER (WHERE s.grp = '<none>')), 0) AS "<none>"
FROM generate_series(0, 23) AS h(hr)
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT "startTime", total_tokens, CASE WHEN api_key = 'SEARCH_AGENT_KEY' THEN 'Search Agent' WHEN model_group IN ('glm52','glm5.1-w8a8','glm53','glm5.1') THEN 'glm-text' WHEN model_group IN ('deepseek-v4-flash','deepseek-v4-flash0731') THEN 'deepseek-v4-flash' ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(model_group,''),'<none>') END AS grp
  FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs"
  WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND api_key IN (${key_group:sqlstring})

panels.title: N18 Tokens by Hour of Day (peak-hour analysis)

panels.description: Same scope and grouping as the top token chart; values in millions (M). Requests with empty model_group are excluded (no <none> series).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("startTime", $bucket), CASE WHEN api_key = 'SEARCH_AGENT_KEY' THEN 'Search Agent' WHEN model_group IN ('glm52', 'glm5.1-w8a8', 'glm53', 'glm5.1') THEN 'glm-text' WHEN model_group IN ('deepseek-v4-flash', 'deepseek-v4-flash0731') THEN 'deepseek-v4-flash' ELSE model_group END AS metric, ROUND(SUM(total_tokens) * 13) AS tokens FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND api_key IN (${key_group:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(model_group, '') <> '' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: N19 Tokens per $bucket (x13 est., no <none>)

panels.description: Request trend bucketed by request COMPLETION time (endTime), unlike the leading chart which buckets by startTime. Same merged model groups, $bucket, key-group scope and stacked-bar style as the leading requests chart. Requests without endTime are excluded.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("endTime", $bucket), CASE WHEN api_key = 'SEARCH_AGENT_KEY' THEN 'Search Agent' WHEN model_group IN ('glm52', 'glm5.1-w8a8', 'glm53', 'glm5.1') THEN 'glm-text' WHEN model_group IN ('deepseek-v4-flash', 'deepseek-v4-flash0731') THEN 'deepseek-v4-flash' ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(model_group, ''), '<none>') END AS metric, COUNT(*) AS requests FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("endTime") AND api_key IN (${key_group:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
